_comment: Recommended per-PLUGIN settings, offered as an apply-or-skip ask of the install and configure walks and read by scripts/plugin-settings.js; both apply the claude-hud row through scripts/hud-statusline.js, after the statusLine it gates. A plugin ships its own defaults; this catalog holds only the keys THIS plugin has a reason to change, each with a `why` a user can weigh. Row shape: `verified` (the exact plugin version + file the keys were read from - a key the plugin does not read is a silent no-op, so never add one from memory), `scope` (`account` when the plugin's config file is account-level whichever scope the plugin was installed at), and `targets[]` - `file` (path relative to the ACCOUNT config dir: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude), `settings` (the object to deep-merge), `why` (per top-level key group), the optional `requires_path` (dotted path that must already exist in the target, else the target is skipped - a patch to a block the plugin's own setup writes must not invent that block), and the optional `chosen_by` (key -> another dotted path whose presence means the user already chose that key, so it is reported and kept). The script only ADDS missing keys by default: a value the user already chose is reported as a difference and kept unless they explicitly pick replace.

claude-hud.verified: claude-hud 0.15.0 (tag v0.15.0, 2026-11-02; the newest release on 2026-11-10) - src/config.ts DEFAULT_CONFIG (key names + shipped defaults: every key below present and unchanged since 0.13.1; 0.14.0 adds only display.showLaunchDir), mergeConfig and migrateLegacyLayout (a legacy layout key migrated only while lineLayout is absent), src/schema.ts (lineLayout compact = a single line; showSeparators = a rule between the session and activity lines, compact only; the refresh note: refreshInterval on the statusLine entry, 30s or more on Windows Git Bash) and collector.mjs claudePaths (<config dir>/plugins/claude-hud/config.json); 0.15.0 drops commands/configure.md and the README's Auto-Refresh section (/hud replaces /claude-hud:setup and /claude-hud:configure); ported from alfred-code, whose row was first read on 0.8.0 and last on 0.12.1; re-read 2026-11-10

why.lineLayout: claude-hud's compact layout (its schema: 'single line'): one line under the prompt instead of the multi-line default, so the HUD costs the least terminal height in every session
why.showSeparators: compact without the rule between the session line and the activity lines
why.display: what a session actually runs, on screen: skills / MCP servers / agents / tools, the config counts that say whether this project's rules and hooks loaded, the cost, the effort level (invisible after a runtime /effort otherwise) and the prompt-cache expiry, which decides whether a pause costs a full re-read
why.gitStatus: unpushed commits and the working-tree file counts: the two things worth knowing before a commit

why.statusLine: Claude Code re-runs the statusline only on events (a message, /compact, a mode change, a rate-limit reset, a cache expiry), so every time-based field (usage reset countdown, session duration) freezes while a session is idle; claude-hud's refresh note (hud schema) asks for a refreshInterval to keep them ticking (30s or more on Windows Git Bash), and 5s is the interval 0.8.0 suggested
